ibili-cn:cv1793434:b0025:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0026"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0026","text":"【和牌的容易度】一向听，进张不太多了","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【和牌的容易度】一向听，进张不太多了","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0027"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0027","text":"【打点】门平宝牌1~3，足够了","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【打点】门平宝牌1~3，足够了","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0028"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0028","text":"【牌的危险度】没有通过的筋牌比较多，7万、5索都很危险","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【牌的危险度】没有通过的筋牌比较多，7万、5索都很危险","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0029"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0029","text":"【弃和成功率】现物两张、筋牌一张，估计能够弃和成功","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【弃和成功率】现物两张、筋牌一张，估计能够弃和成功","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0030"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0030","text":"除了基本的判断材料之外，南场的TOP立直，看来是想确定自己的领先优势。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"除了基本的判断材料之外，南场的TOP立直，看来是想确定自己的领先优势。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0031"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0031","text":"这样的状况下，为了减少自己的迷惑、冷静的进行攻守判断，有攻守判断的“脊柱”材料是非常重要的。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"这样的状况下，为了减少自己的迷惑、冷静的进行攻守判断，有攻守判断的“脊柱”材料是非常重要的。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0032"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0032","text":"这个讲座里，我比较推荐以“自己的向听数”来进行判断。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"这个讲座里，我比较推荐以“自己的向听数”来进行判断。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0033"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0033","text":"具体来说就是，“要与立直对攻，自己要先听牌了”是基本；“一向听的话，就可以攻一巡”，这么记就好了。","sourceSegments"
